scope: Apply today's public game licensing to an independent PC release. UE6 features are plans, and no future UE6 price is inferred.
requested: 언리얼을 쓸 이유 및 Godot 무료 강조, Unity 포함 3개 엔진 후반 비교

section.decision: Unreal: evaluate existing production investment, tools, and intention to publish in Fortnite/UEFN.

Godot: nodes and signals, optional GDScript. MIT, commercial games included, no per-seat fee and no engine royalties. Include the engine copyright and license notice when distributing its binary; link is an accepted route. This is engine pricing, not the cost of stores, staff, ports or services.

Unity: GameObject/component and C#. Own-game studio financial threshold is its gross revenue and funding over most recent 12 months. Personal eligible up to and including US$200,000. US 2026 Pro annual prepaid US$2,310 per seat; enterprise and custom terms outside illustration. Runtime fee cancelled.

section.assumptions: Two developers using the Editor, one independent PC game sold only on Steam. First quarter product lifetime gross receipts reach US$1,200,000 before store cut. Both Unity Pro seats assumed for one full prepaid year at US 2026 list price, before taxes. Unreal standard 5% royalty; no other exclusions, EGS sales, qualifying Launch Everywhere rate or custom agreement. Godot engine license only. These totals illustrate different bases and are not universal lifetime prices.

section.decision: Editorial conclusion: there is no need to adopt UE6 solely to implement the mechanic. Compare an actual port of the first room, production investment, workflow, licensing and target-device testing.

costsUnit: US dollars, no tax or third-party fees
